caption: The drawing features two distinct sketches placed vertically on a beige or off-white sheet. The upper sketch, smaller and roughly square-shaped, depicts a simple outline of a rounded vessel or jar. Across the upper part of the jar, within a zigzag border, is hand-drawn text reading "LIBERTYFOR S.A.M.BOY.NJERSY" in capital letters. The lower sketch, rectangular and larger, contains a horizontal banner or plaque filled with angular, zigzag edges along the top. On this banner, the text reads: "LIBERTYFOREV S.A.M.B.OY.NJERSY" in large, bold, capital letters, with slight adjustment for spacing. There is a small hand-drawn motif resembling a pointing hand or arrow on the left side, and the background behind the text is shaded with grayish or purple-blue watercolor, creating a contrast with the beige background. The overall composition arranges the two sketches in the center of the page, with significant empty space surrounding them.
title: Small Pot or Crock
